acceptance_rules: Every accepted case has an id, workflow status, owner, priority, next action, escalation, confidence, and audit trail.
Fraud, OTP, PIN, password, or missing-money signals are urgent and owned by Trust & Safety.
Incomplete reports remain in_review and ask for clarification instead of inventing evidence.
Consent is false by default and redacted text is used for external AI processing.

intentional_failure.expected: The worker must not guess a root cause; it returns Needs clarification with low confidence and a specific follow-up question.
